title: Replace CDN links with GitHub Pages and modernize dictionary theme
description:
## Summary

The legacy `rsacdn.link` CDN is being retired. This repo now publishes via **GitHub Pages** (enabled on `main`, root). This PR repoints the data dictionary references to Pages URLs and removes the CDN-hosted styling from the dictionary sources.

## Changes

- **Repoint data dictionary links (milestone files):** the `indexes` dictionary now links to `https://rstudio.github.io/academy-python-stock-portfolios/assets/indexes_dictionary.html` instead of `rsacdn.link`.
- **Modernize the dictionary sources:** all three `assets/*_dictionary.qmd` files (indexes, sectors, sp500) were R Markdown (`output: html_document` + `cerulean` theme + a `teachthis` CDN stylesheet). They now use native Quarto `format: html` with the default **cosmo** theme and `embed-resources: true` (self-contained single files, no external CDN assets).
- **Re-rendered** all three dictionary HTML files.

## Verification

- `grep` confirms **no** `rsacdn`, `cerulean`, or `teachthis` references remain in any `.qmd` or `.html`.
- Dictionaries re-rendered self-contained (no `_files/` sidecar).
- GitHub Pages enabled and building; live dictionary URL returns HTTP 200.

title: Replace uv sync with a one-line uv install; remove pyproject.toml and uv.lock
description:
## Summary

- Remove `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock`. Learners now install packages with **one unpinned command** in the Terminal instead of `uv sync`:

  ```bash
  uv venv --allow-existing && uv pip install jupyter pandas palmerpenguins plotnine scikit-learn statsmodels
  ```

  There are no lockfiles to keep in sync across the Python learner repos. The same line lives in the course's tutorials (`python/tutorials/academy_intro/_python-install.qmd` in rstudio/academyTutorials).
- README **Getting Started** now covers trusting the folder (Positron opens new folders in Restricted Mode) and selecting the project's `.venv` interpreter, with a pointer to the course's **Set Up Your Project** tutorial.

## Testing

Walked through end to end on staging Workbench (2026.09.0, Positron, Python 3.14.2, uv 0.12.17): clone with New Folder from Git, trust the folder, run the one-liner (119 packages, a few minutes), select the `(uv: …)` interpreter, then import all six packages and preview a milestone with the `.venv`.

**Note:** unpinned installs currently resolve to **pandas 3.0**. `pd.set_option('mode.copy_on_write', True)` in later milestones now raises a `Pandas4Warning` (the option is a deprecated no-op), and string columns load as `str` rather than `object`.

Companion PR: rstudio/academyTutorials (Python Get Started: Positron-only setup with uv).

title: Sync with the normalized mentor copy
description:
Brings this repo in line with the normalized mentor copy in rstudio/academyMilestones#1789. From now on, the learner files are **generated** from the mentor copy with `.claude/tools/python/learnerize.py` rather than hand-edited. `/qa-python-project` flags any drift.

**Stacked on #2** (one-line uv install). Merge #2 first; GitHub will then retarget this PR to `main`.

## Changes
- **Naming:** `indexes_05_quarto_python_types.qmd` → `indexes_05_quarto_python-types.qmd`, matching the other files.
- **indexes_04:** the instructions name the function `calc_CAGR()` (they said `calc_cagr()`), matching the code that milestone 05 reuses.
- **indexes_01:** drops a stray `{target=…}` on the dictionary link.
- **Track files:**
  - track_01: the `html-basics.html` URL is fixed, and the publishing link now goes to Positron's [Publish Your Work](https://positron.posit.co/publish-to-connect.html) page.
  - track_02: "Great Tables", and a duplicated "using" is removed.
- **`.gitignore`:** also ignores `.quarto/`.

Everything else is regenerated byte-for-byte; the only other differences are collapsed runs of blank lines.

## Verification
- **Privacy gate:** `lint_milestones.py learner` is clean. That covers no solution chunks, no mentor-only content, the install line identical to academyTutorials `_python-install.qmd`, and all linked dictionaries, images and answer keys present.
- **Learner simulation:** with the mentor solutions injected into these files, every chunk runs under pandas 3.0.6 with no errors or warnings. All 3 compare checks return an empty DataFrame, and all 3 report a difference when the data is perturbed.
